task_prompt: You are given the following quantum programming task. Implement 4 steps of a discrete-time quantum walk on a cycle of 0 nodes in Qiskit (position register + coin qubit, increment/decrement circuits), and print the final position distribution showing ballistic spread. Your answer must be the complete working code only, runnable from top to bottom.
